components.name: Volt Action
components.description: Primary action for the next meaningful commercial step.
components.css: .ds-button-accent { min-height: 48px; padding: 13px 20px; border: 1px solid #b8ff3d; border-radius: 4px; background: #b8ff3d; color: #0b0d0e; font: 800 13px Manrope, sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-button-accent:hover { background: #ffffff; } .ds-button-accent:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-button-accent:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0b0d0e; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Obsidian Action
components.description: Default command button on light surfaces.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 13px 20px; border: 1px solid #0b0d0e; border-radius: 4px; background: #0b0d0e; color: #ffffff; font: 800 13px Manrope, sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #232628; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0b0d0e; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Commerce Input
components.description: Persistent-label field for checkout and search.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; color: #3c4143; font: 800 12px Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid #73797d; border-radius: 4px; background: #ffffff; color: #0b0d0e; font: 400 16px Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: #0b0d0e; outline: 1px solid #0b0d0e; outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Category Filter
components.description: Compact category selection in the catalog toolbar.
components.css: .ds-filter { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(11,13,14,.16); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: #0b0d0e; font: 800 12px Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-filter[aria-pressed=true] { border-color: #0b0d0e; background: #0b0d0e; color: #ffffff; } .ds-filter:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0b0d0e; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Demo Notice
components.description: Transparent separation between simulated and live commerce.
components.html: Productos de demostración. No se realizará ningún cobro.
components.css: .ds-demo { padding: 14px 16px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(11,13,14,.16); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(11,13,14,.16); background: #f4f3ef; color: #0b0d0e; font: 400 13px/1.5 Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-demo strong { font-weight: 800; }

narrative.overview: A calm sports magazine that can complete a purchase, balancing expressive campaign scale with precise commerce controls.

rules.name: The Volt Rule
rules.body: Use Volt for the next meaningful action or one decisive phrase.

rules.name: Flat by Default
rules.body: Use tonal bands, borders and media instead of shadows.

dos: Preserve the Bone, Obsidian and Volt hierarchy.
Keep live commerce data sourced from BilBildin.
donts: Do not add decorative gradients or nested cards.
